subject: Limited-run asset bridge: MAP, sandbox terms, and data usage covenant
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@brightretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-01T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Limited-run asset bridge proposal — MAP + sandbox terms

Hi Elaine — great to meet earlier. As promised, I sketched a short mutual action plan for a limited-run exchange of evaluation materials (prompt pack + 2 curated testcases) so your ML team can run a 2-week performance and safety sweep in your staging environment. Key points below — please flag anything missing: 

- Deliverables from Redwood: promptpack-sample.zip (example prompts + metadata), 2 curated testcases (edge-case focus), and a 48-hour ephemeral sandbox with controlled API tokens.
- Usage constraints: assets are for evaluation only, may not be used to train BrightRetail models or redistributed. Sandbox access bound to 3 seats, 100k tokens total over 14 days.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 scoping checklist to be provided; sandbox runs in BrightRetail VPC peered to Redwood IDP.
- Timeline (proposed):
  * Day 0 (you sign MPA): we stage assets + grant sandbox tokens
  * Day 1–14: evaluation window; daily syncs optional
  * Day 15: handback & short report; assets either returned or destroyed per MPA

I attached an initial MPA draft (mpa-draft.pdf) and a lightweight sandbox-access guide. If this looks right, could you loop in procurement/legal for a quick review and sign-off? I can prep a DocuSign envelope once we have confirmation of stakeholders and any redlines.

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: mpa-draft.pdf, sandbox-access-guide.pdf
From: Elaine Park <elaine@brightretail.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Chan <procurement@brightretail.com>, BrightRetail Legal <legal@brightretail.com>
Date: 2025-07-02T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Limited-run asset bridge proposal — MAP + sandbox terms

Thanks Mateo — appreciate the concise MAP. A few quick clarifications from our side before we route to legal/procurement: 

1) Usage limits: can you confirm whether the 100k token cap is aggregated across all seats or per-seat? We expect a handful of long-context tests, so aggregate would be fine if flexible.
2) Data handling: BrightRetail requires an explicit retention window for logs generated in the sandbox (we prefer logs auto-deleted after 30 days unless a security incident).
3) Export controls: our legal wants an explicit list of what constitutes "returned or destroyed" (checksums/manifest).

Tom/legal — looping you in to confirm commercial and contractual steps. Mateo — if you can confirm the three bullets, I’ll move this to procurement for redlines.

Best,
Elaine
Senior Product Manager, BrightRetail
elaine@brightretail.com

> Hi Elaine — great to meet earlier. As promised, I sketched a short mutual action plan...
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@brightretail.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Chan <procurement@brightretail.com>
Date: 2025-07-02T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Limited-run asset bridge proposal — MAP + sandbox terms

Elaine/Tom — quick note from Legal/PD side: we can accommodate the 30-day log retention request but need to codify it in Section 4.b of the MPA; will add exact language for "auto-deletion" and incident carve-outs. On the export/return checklist, I’ll attach a short manifest template to the MPA (checksums + file list).

A couple of practical constraints to flag so procurement is aware: 
- Promptpack-sample.zip contains a subset of Redwood prompts and sample annotations; it is explicitly licensed for evaluation only and cannot be used to seed or fine-tune models.
- For the sandbox, we require that testcases flagged as "security incidents" are immediately preserved for forensic analysis — we list preservation exceptions in the manifest.

Attaching the updated MPA draft (mpa-draft.pdf) with a manifest appendix. If procurement/legal want to redline, please return comments in the DocuSign workflow or as inline PDF comments.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: mpa-draft.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@brightretail.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Chan <procurement@brightretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-03T09:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Limited-run asset bridge proposal — MAP + sandbox terms

Quick technical clarifications from infra: 
- Token cap model: the 100k tokens is aggregated for the entire sandbox (not per-seat); we can increase to 150k if you expect longer-context evaluation. Tell us the expected longest single-run length and we’ll reserve headroom.
- Sandbox access: we will issue 3 scoped API keys tied to BrightRetail team emails. Keys are rate-limited at 60 requests/minute and will expire automatically at the end of Day 14.
- Data deletion: sandbox request/response logs will be retained for 30 days and then flushed; we will store an audit manifest for 90 days (manifest = metadata only, not payload) for compliance traceability.

If that model works, I’ll update the sandbox-access-guide.pdf and the MPA appendix to reflect exact fields for the manifest.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
From: Elaine Park <elaine@brightretail.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Chan <procurement@brightretail.com>, BrightRetail Legal <legal@brightretail.com>
Date: 2025-07-04T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Limited-run asset bridge proposal — MAP, sandbox terms, and data usage covenant

Appreciate the quick answers — this looks good and aligns with our needs. Two small asks before we proceed to signature: 
1) Please increase the token cap to 150k aggregate (we have a couple of long-context passes).
2) Add an explicit clause that promptpack-sample.zip cannot be used to benchmark against production BrightRetail models without written permission.

Tom/legal — if you’re comfortable, can we do a 48-hour legal review once Mateo/Marissa push the updated MPA into DocuSign? If so, procurement will approve and we’ll sign.

Mateo/Marissa/Karthik — if you can confirm you’ll push the updated MPA (with the 150k change and the benchmark restriction) by EOD today, I’ll ask procurement to queue approval and then sign via DocuSign. Also, please include the sandbox-access-guide.pdf and the promptpack-sample.zip in the DocuSign package or a shared Drive link.

Thanks — Elaine
Senior Product Manager, BrightRetail
elaine@brightretail.com
